name: M3_PMS100MI_LstOperations
description: List all operations for a specific released manufacturing order. Returns one record per operation belonging to the given facility, product number, and manufacturing order.

inputParameters.name: FACI
inputParameters.description: Facility where the manufacturing order is processed.

inputParameters.name: PRNO
inputParameters.description: Product number for the manufactured item.

outputParameters.name: CONO
outputParameters.description: Company number that owns the manufacturing order.

outputParameters.name: FACI
outputParameters.description: Facility where the manufacturing order is processed.

outputParameters.name: PRNO
outputParameters.description: Product number for the manufactured item.

outputParameters.name: MFNO
outputParameters.description: Manufacturing order number.

outputParameters.name: OPNO
outputParameters.description: Operation number within the manufacturing order.

outputParameters.name: ITDS
outputParameters.description: Description of the manufactured product.

outputParameters.name: OPDS
outputParameters.description: Short description of the operation.

outputParameters.name: WOST
outputParameters.description: Status of the operation in the order lifecycle.

outputParameters.name: SEQS
outputParameters.description: Sequencing status of the operation for scheduling.

outputParameters.name: PLG1
outputParameters.description: Work center used for advanced planning and scheduling of the operation.

outputParameters.name: PLGR
outputParameters.description: Work center where the operation is performed.

outputParameters.name: PLGF
outputParameters.description: Resource that is fixed for use by this operation.

outputParameters.name: REAR
outputParameters.description: Planning area to which the operation's work center belongs.

outputParameters.name: PRIO
outputParameters.description: Priority of the manufacturing order for planning purposes.

outputParameters.name: FXTI
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether the operation's run time is fixed regardless of quantity.

outputParameters.name: CTCD
outputParameters.description: Quantity basis used for the operation's price and run time.

outputParameters.name: SETI
outputParameters.description: Planned setup time required before the operation starts.

outputParameters.name: FILL
outputParameters.description: Reserved filler field with no business meaning.

outputParameters.name: PSSQ
outputParameters.description: Co-sorting key used to group operations with similar characteristics in dispatch lists.

outputParameters.name: UMAS
outputParameters.description: Accumulated reported labor setup time for the operation.

outputParameters.name: UMAT
outputParameters.description: Accumulated reported labor run time for the operation.

outputParameters.name: MAQT
outputParameters.description: Accumulated manufactured quantity for the manufacturing order.

outputParameters.name: SCQT
outputParameters.description: Total scrapped quantity for the manufacturing order.

outputParameters.name: ORQT
outputParameters.description: Ordered quantity in the basic unit of measure.

outputParameters.name: NNQT
outputParameters.description: Quantity reported as completed for the manufacturing order.

outputParameters.name: POOC
outputParameters.description: Code controlling how secondary operations overlap with the primary operation.

outputParameters.name: SLAT
outputParameters.description: Code defining how the operation overlaps or queues to the next operation.

outputParameters.name: SLAC
outputParameters.description: Overlap base value used together with the overlap code when scheduling to the next operation.

outputParameters.name: NXOP
outputParameters.description: Number of the next operation in the routing sequence.

outputParameters.name: APON
outputParameters.description: Primary operation number used for scheduling and linking parallel operations.

outputParameters.name: RESR
outputParameters.description: Resource restriction value used to limit which resources can perform the operation.

outputParameters.name: SPLK
outputParameters.description: Method used to split the operation across multiple machines or operations.

outputParameters.name: SPLN
outputParameters.description: Number of operations created when the operation is split.

outputParameters.name: SPSZ
outputParameters.description: Quantity per split operation when splitting the operation by quantity.

outputParameters.name: PRAP
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether the order has been processed by the advanced planning and scheduling tool.

outputParameters.name: SPLT
outputParameters.description: Code indicating whether the operation or quantity has been split.

outputParameters.name: RPDT
outputParameters.description: Date when the latest reporting transaction for this operation was performed.

outputParameters.name: RPTM
outputParameters.description: Time when the latest reporting transaction for this operation was performed.

outputParameters.name: STDT
outputParameters.description: Planned start date of the operation.

outputParameters.name: MSTI
outputParameters.description: Planned start time of the operation.

outputParameters.name: FIDT
outputParameters.description: Planned finish date of the operation.

outputParameters.name: MFTI
outputParameters.description: Planned finish time of the operation.

outputParameters.name: FRCD
outputParameters.description: Forced start date overriding normal scheduling for the operation.

outputParameters.name: FRCT
outputParameters.description: Forced start time overriding normal scheduling for the operation.

outputParameters.name: TXT1
outputParameters.description: Free text line 1 for the operation.

outputParameters.name: TXT2
outputParameters.description: Free text line 2 for the operation.

outputParameters.name: PRNM
outputParameters.description: Planned number of machines used for the operation.

outputParameters.name: SENP
outputParameters.description: Planned number of workers used for operation setup.

outputParameters.name: PRNP
outputParameters.description: Planned number of workers used during operation run time.

outputParameters.name: PLNR
outputParameters.description: Planned number of resources assigned to the operation.

outputParameters.name: LMDT
outputParameters.description: Date when the operation record was last changed.

outputParameters.name: CHNO
outputParameters.description: Change number associated with the latest update of the operation.

outputParameters.name: CHID
outputParameters.description: User ID who last changed the operation.

outputParameters.name: PITI
outputParameters.description: Run time per price/time quantity used when planning the operation.

outputParameters.name: PIT2
outputParameters.description: Run time expressed in hours per unit.

outputParameters.name: WLDE
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether the operation uses finite capacity planning.

outputParameters.name: SET2
outputParameters.description: Planned labor setup time expressed in hours.

outputParameters.name: EFFA
outputParameters.description: Efficiency factor used to adjust planned time for the operation.

outputParameters.name: PRET
outputParameters.description: Preparation time inserted between this operation and the next.

outputParameters.name: POTM
outputParameters.description: Post-operation time inserted between this operation and the next.

outputParameters.name: SCHN
outputParameters.description: Schedule number grouping the order in production planning.

outputParameters.name: SCHS
outputParameters.description: Sequence number of the order within the schedule.

outputParameters.name: WHLO
outputParameters.description: Warehouse where the manufacturing order is produced or stored.

outputParameters.name: PIT3
outputParameters.description: Run time expressed in hours, adjusted for subcontracting when applicable.

outputParameters.name: MDOP
outputParameters.description: Maximum allowed operation duration as a percentage of theoretical time.

outputParameters.name: PSTH
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether the operation may be freely planned when the manufacturing order is on short-term hold.

outputParameters.name: DPLG
outputParameters.description: Alternate work center where the operation was actually performed.

outputParameters.name: SUBC
outputParameters.description: Control setting defining how purchase or requisition orders are created for subcontract operations.

outputParameters.name: RSDT
outputParameters.description: Actual start date when the operation was first reported.

outputParameters.name: RBUP
outputParameters.description: Remaining buffer percentage for the operation.

outputParameters.name: CRTR
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether the operation uses a critical resource that needs special monitoring.

outputParameters.name: AMAO
outputParameters.description: Number of workdays material should be reserved before the operation start date.

outputParameters.name: PLLT
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether the work center controls how lot numbers are created.
